the E-691 experiment has made the first direct observation of charm photoproduction, has provided the first direct measurement of the total charm photoproduction cross-section and has provided the first measurement of the D/sup 1/0 production cross-section.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the charm photoproduction cross-section is approximately 2.6 microb/sup 2//nucleon, that the ratio of the cross-section for anticharm to charmed quark production is approximately 1.2 and that charm production is predominantly at small x/sub F/.
the results are in general agreement with theoretical expectations and with the results of other charm photoproduction experiments.
